messages.subject: Overdispersion opencount
parts:
Hello unmarked group,

I am currently trying to run some pcountopen models on monthly data, but I am getting overdispersion with all three prob. distributions: Poisson, NB and ZIP. I need to admit that I have a very small sample of 9.  Any comments or advices would be very much appreciated.

Thanks in advance.

Cheers

Stvs

hi Steeves,
 Its unclear what 9 is .... 9 sites? replicates? total?
 In either case, I can't imagine the model performing well at all with really low sample sizes. Caution is urged.
regards
andy
